text: Wikipedia Jump to content Diori Diori Pogu ni Alaman Sian Wikipedia Sadarion: Sabtu , 5 September 2026 Wikipedia Batak Toba Sopo Parbinotoan lungkas na marhata Batak Toba . Saonari nunga adong 1,486 guritan na tarsurat di bagasan hata Batak Toba . Guritan na tarpillit Demban ( Hata Indonesia : Sirih ) sanga digoari muse burangir sanga napuran i ma sada suansuanan sian Indonesia na mangolu manginsir sanga magusande tu sada batang ni hau. Molo di bagasan abahan, mangallang napuran hombar ma muse dohot gambir , pinang , timbaho dohot hapur . Alai molo gahat mangallang hapur, boi manega ( periodentitis ) mambahen sega ipon . Di halak Malayu , napuran on dibahen gabe ubat ( fitofarmaka ), dung i dipangke muse tu acara adat rumpun Melayu. Di Indonesia, napuran on gabe suansuanan na sudung sian Propinsi Hapuloan Riau . Halak di Hapuloan Riau maniop tongtong adat mangallang napuran, sudung tu adat manambut tondong na ro tu huta ni halahi. Demban i ma suansuanan tangkasan di Indonesia na tubu manjilir manang mangusande tu kambona ni hau na asing. ( Sasingkopna... ) Gombar na tarpillit Proklamasi Kemerdekaan Republik Indonesia na dijahahon Soekarno jala didongani Mohammad Hatta di ari 17 Agustus 1945 Gombar on dienet sian Wikimedia Commons Tingting On ma tingting na tarsurat di bagasan Pogu ni Alaman Wikipedia Batak Toba: Angka guritan na tarsurat mamangke Surat Batak , boi jahaon hamu di dison . Materi parsiajaran ni Surat Batak boi dijahaon salpu alaman Wikipedia:Marsiajar Surat Batak Toba on. Bahen guritan na imbaru Aha do Wikipedia i? Boi ma dohonon, Wikipedia i songon sada “halinu ni pustaha” manang “pustaha halinu” na pinadomudomu ni hatopan ni panggurit sian saluhut portibi on, jala ise pe boi do manongos guritan tu “pustaha halinu” saguru ragam hata ni hatopan i. Molo adong hita na taronjar rohana naeng manongos guritan na imbaru tu “pustaha halinu”, nauli jala na denggan ma i, une jala pintor boi do ulahononhon. Alai itaparrohahon ma ruhut-ruhut dohot uhum ni “pustaha halinu” na sian pamotoan ( lisensi ) ni hatopan na margoar Creative Commons BY-SA . Guritan manang tongosan di “pustaha halinu” on, boi dipatingkos manang dipargunahon, alai asa marpanghorhon na denggan, sian pamotoan ni Creative Commons BY-SA ma. Porlu hita boto, ia nasa guritan manang tongosan di “pustaha halinu” dihobasi angka dongan panggurit di bagasan haradeon ni roha sambing, jala tongtong do nasida mangula sada partungkoan. Ingkon barita na toho do isi ni guritan nang tongosan i, boi hatindanghonon marhite pustaha, jala mangihuthon ruhut-ruhut ni sigurit pustaha. Adong do alaman panungkunan na boi mangurupi dongan na naeng manongos guritan na imbaru tu “pustaha halinu” on. Unang hita maila masisungkunan manang mangido pangurupion, tarlumobi tu dongan na naeng manggurit dope. Laos boi do tapargunahon alaman on molo naeng manongos guritan na imbaru. Ulaon Wikimedia na asing Wikipedia Batak Toba , ensiklopedia lungkas na marhata Batak Toba, diparadehon pere sian Wikimedia Foundation , i ma dalihan marsiadapari. Nasing ni marhata Batak Toba, Wikipedia ture di pigapiga parhataan nasing na dipartuturhon di Indonesia: Aceh , Bali , Banjar , Banyumas , Batak Toba , Betawi , Bugis , Gorontalo , Iban , Jawa , Auf La Gomera verfangen sich die Passatwolken in den Bergen und spenden einem jahrtausendealten, immergrünen Nebelwald wertvolle Feuchtigkeit. Die Felsen vulkanischen Ursprungs schichten sich zu bizarren Formationen auf. Der Massentourismus ist der Insel bis heute erspart geblieben. Besondere Traditionen haben sich auf der Kanareninsel erhalten, wie die Pfeifsprache oder die Fortbewegung mit Stangen. title: New Effects in Stories from Meta AI
description: New AI effects in Instagram Stories using the latest capabilities in Meta AI.
headings: New Effects in Stories from Meta AI
A Redesigned Composer for Faster Editing
text: New Effects in Stories from Meta AI Skip to main content Log in Back to blog # PRODUCT # ANNOUNCEMENTS New Effects in Stories from Meta AI Posted on Takeaways • Instagram is adding over 30 new effects in Stories powered by Muse Image, the first AI image generation model from Meta Superintelligence Labs. • There is also a redesigned effects browser experience that makes it easy to preview effects before you try them on your photos. • These updates are available in the US only. Update (July 10, 2026): Earlier this week, we announced that one way for people to generate images in Meta AI is by @-mentioning public Instagram accounts that they want to reference. Our intent was to provide a useful creative tool and to give people control over whether their public content could be referenced in this way. We've heard the feedback that this feature missed the mark, so it's no longer available. Every day, millions of people use Instagram to share their personal creativity with the people they care about. Today, we're making sharing Stories even more fun with over 30 new effects powered by Muse Image , the first AI image generation model from Meta Superintelligence Labs. These effects transform your photos with a single tap. Several of these effects were designed by Instagram creators, who used Meta AI to amplify their creativity and bring their ideas to life. New AI Effects in Stories In the US, we’ve added over 30 new effects that use the latest image generation capabilities from Meta AI. Meta AI has been developed to uniquely understand Instagram videos and photos and can interpret your photo's scene — the lighting, composition, and subject — to make nuanced edits that feel natural and true to you. You can subtly enhance the lighting in your photos with an effect like Night Flash or Disposable, try on new looks with Puffer or Paper Doll, or turn your Instagram profile into a personalized keychain with IG Charms. If you don’t see an effect you love, you can create your own by typing in a prompt at the bottom of the composer. A Redesigned Composer for Faster Editing We're also introducing a redesigned composer that makes it easier to preview and select the perfect effect for every photo in your camera roll. After you’ve taken or selected a photo, you can scroll through a carousel of thumbnails showing how each effect transforms your image so you can edit and share more quickly, with fewer tries. As always, however you choose to edit your photos, you remain in control of how you show up and what you share. Human Creativity Drives Us Human creativity is behind every piece of content shared on Instagram, and we believe that AI is at its best when it enhances that creativity. To highlight this, we partnered with five creators to develop a curated set of AI effects that reflect their unique creative styles. These creators – @zzdesign , @rourke , @aader.archv , @harukohayakawa , and @dontaecatlett – joined members of the Instagram team in New York to design these custom AI effects. Their visions were the driving force, AI simply helped bring their ideas to life. To try them out, check out the “New” tab within the effects carousel. Creativity with Control Meta is also launching the ability to @mention friends’ public Instagram accounts in Meta AI and generate creative AI images featuring them, such as personalized birthday cards, group trip memes, or playful edits between friends. It's an upgrade to what people can create with AI features at Meta, making it more personal, fun, and social. We want our community to have control over how their content is used for creation. If you don't want anyone to create with your Instagram content using AI features at Meta, you can turn it off by going to Instagram Settings > Sharing and Reuse . This setting is currently available on mobile only for now. We hope to continue to bring more fun, engaging AI features like these, alongside controls to manage how your content can be used in AI-generated content, to additional surfaces and people soon.
